name: Add search files
description: The conversation modifies `Chat.vue` to implement an AI-powered document search feature. The `addSearchMessage` method is updated to resolve a query from either the current editor text or the last user message. It calls `this.$storex.api.knowledge.aiSearch(query)` and formats the response using a new `buildAiSearchMessage` helper. The helper generates a markdown message containing the answer, queries used, and a sources section with document metadata. Error handling and a `searchingInKnowledge` loading flag are also properly implemented around the async call.
